notes.title: Silent Cleaning v.1.1.3 Update
notes.content: [p]We’ve cleaned up the following bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, opening the front door would make the game unplayable.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your bug reports and cooperation![/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy your cleaning adventures ✨[/p]

notes.title: Silent Cleaning v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Thank you so much for playing “Silent Cleaning”![/b] 🧹✨[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could make the game unplayable under certain areas or conditions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted background music playback in specific areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled certain internal functions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some in-game images and warning messages.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now switch cleaning tools using the mouse wheel scroll.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your bug reports and support!
We hope you continue to enjoy your cleaning adventures. ✨[/p]

notes.title: Released today! 🧟 Catch Gatchman’s live stream Aug 8, 9 PM (JST)!
notes.content: [p]The horror game [i]Silent Cleaning[/i], featuring Kao products, is out today![/p][p]We’re grateful for the many reactions we’ve already received.[/p][p]Tonight, Friday, Aug 8, from 9 PM (JST), Gatchman will be doing a live gameplay stream—don’t miss it![/p][p]↓[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w_PLJJcm4GQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]This game is free to stream and monetize.
